info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Petsupply Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Catalog Pet Supply Recliner Detail API enables businesses to create and manage detailed information about pet supply recliners. This endpoint allows users to submit comprehensive data regarding each recliner, including specifications, images, and pricing. Typical consumers include e-commerce platforms and inventory management systems that require accurate product details for marketing and sales purposes. By utilizing this API, businesses can enhance their catalog offerings and ensure customers have access to the latest product information.

post.summary: Create Recliner Details for Pet Supply
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create new recliner details specifically designed for pet supplies. It accepts the necessary data in the request body and returns the details of the created recliner.

requestBody.description: Request body for creating or updating details of a pet supply recliner. The body should contain the necessary information to specify the recliner's attributes and characteristics.
